ios.desc:
The best app for making music playlists and the original AI playlist maker. Connect your Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, or Amazon Music account to start discovering new music with AI.

- Enter a prompt like "Early 2000's pop music", "Working out at the gym, rap", or "Music similar to Taylor Swift and Joji" and we'll make you a playlist using AI.

- Upload an image (like a music festival lineup) and PlaylistAI will make you a playlist of the artists in the image.

- Provide a video (like a TikTok that plays multiple songs) and make a playlist of the songs in that video. 

- Create personalized playlists featuring the top tracks and artists in your listening history. 

- Share a custom music festival lineup featuring your top artists

Additional Features:
- Instantly make multi-hour long playlists
- Discover playlists made by other people
- Customizable app icons and app themes
- Playlist sort options that aren't available in the Spotify app, such as sorting by song popularity


Not officially affiliated with Spotify, TikTok, or Apple Music in any way.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an app to create Spotify playlists from music festival posters

quotes.text:
I run an iOS app on the side thats at ~$2500 MRR. It lets you generate music playlists from a prompt, like "make me a playlist for music to listen to while coding". I launched in January and it took 2 weeks to get the first $2k in revenue.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/playlistai-playlist-maker/id1631703551
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Side project of more than $2k monthly revenue? what's your project?

quotes.text:
Hey HN, I'm Brett and I'm an iOS developer.

LineupSupply uses Apple's Vision framework to read text from an image and then the Spotify API to create a playlist using that text. So if you provide a music festival poster, it will grab the artist names from the lineup and make a playlist for that music festival.

Often when going to a music festival I want a playlist to listen to the artists that will be performing. I couldn't find any other service that automates this, so I made one myself.

The app is free to create as many playlists as you want, but does have a one time in-app purchase of $1.99 to unlock additional features (control over how many songs per artist, custom app icons, etc). You do need to login with your Spotify account, but Spotify Premium isn't required.

I made this app with SwiftUI and its available on iOS and iPadOS. You can technically download it on macOS too, but it's a port of the iPad app.
